services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating

services.title: Commercial Redecoration
services.desc: Refresh your office, shop, or café with minimal disruption. We work to your schedule, manage waste responsibly, and leave sites clean daily.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Proper prep is the secret to lasting results. We strip old paint, fill cracks, sand surfaces, and treat damp issues before any topcoat goes on.

about_pullquote: I started P&M because I believe corners should never be cut — prep work makes all the difference.
about_para_1: P&M Property Maintenance was founded over a decade ago by a team frustrated with sloppy paintwork and poor customer communication in Leeds. We set out to prove that decorating could be done properly: meticulous prep, quality materials, honest timescales, and no hidden costs. Today, we've redecorated hundreds of homes across Leeds and the surrounding areas, from Victorian terraces to modern family properties.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up on time, respecting your home, and leaving spaces that customers genuinely love. Our reputation is built on repeat business and word-of-mouth referrals — people trust us because we deliver. Whether it's a small bedroom refresh or a full-house repaint, we approach every job with the same professionalism and pride.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Fantastic work from start to finish. Paul and the team completely redecorated our lounge — moved all the furniture, protected everything, and left us with a beautiful space. Very tidy workers, no mess. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had our exterior painted last summer. They sorted the damaged fascias, repaired the render, and the whole house looks fresh again. Fair price, did what they said they'd do, and finished on schedule. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Came in for a free quote, no pressure. They explained what needed doing and why. The actual work was spot-on — the wallpaper in my hallway is perfect. Professional, friendly, and reasonably priced. Top marks.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.
